mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 7.0%) indicates a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS rising by more than 0.25 percentage points in one month) signals aggressive monetary tightening, which increases borrowing costs and dampens economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST falling below 700,000 units in the prior month) indicates weakening consumer demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 700.0.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is rising (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) and inflation is accelerating (CPIAUCSL rising > 0.3% in the prior month), the market anticipates a stagflationary environment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 0.5% AND CPIAUCSL rise > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL rise > 0.3% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0) and a rise in unemployment (UNRATE > 7.5%) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector and labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0 and UNRATE > 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a slowdown in retail sales (RSAFS growth rate < 0.5% in the prior month) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS growth rate < 0.5% and in late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO < 95.0), the contraction in industrial output signals reduced corporate production capacity and future earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0.
